name: Null Transit
detailed_description:
Adrift in the endless void, the captain and crew cling to survival aboard a failing spaceship. Their only hope? Recover a crucial Astronavigator Core before the ship succumbs to the darkness.

FIVE CREW MEMBERS (and a clone). ONE MISSION.

Meet the crew: Captain, Commander, Recon, Engineer, Disciple. Each crew member brings unique strengths, but all are fragile in the face of death.

To avoid unnecessary losses, the captain can send humanoid clones instead—expendable, but at a cost. Every clone drains Ionite, the rare energy source keeping the ship operational. Run out, and the crew will have no choice but to risk their own lives.

How far will you go to keep your crew alive?

A HIGH-STAKES ACTION PLATFORMER

  • Choices Matter. Losing a crew member is permanent. Every decision counts.

  • Master Fluid Movement. Simple controls—jump, dash, and channel energy—that evolve into intricate, parkour-like maneuvers as you improve.

  • Unique Dash-Attack Combat. There is no attack button. Dash through energy to recharge movement and power up your weapons. Every fight is a test of momentum and precision.

  • Distinct Combat Styles. Each crew member wields two unique weapons, shaping how they fight.

    • The Captain strikes from afar with tactical orbital bombardments.

    • The Commander dominates close-quarters combat with brute force.

    • The Recon relies on speed, stealth, and hit-and-run tactics.

    • The Engineer delivers calculated, high-damage strikes.

    • The Disciple controls the battlefield with devastating area attacks.

This ship has seen its share of storms, but it’s not the ship that survives—it’s the crew. Let’s bring her home.

short_description: Null Transit is a high-stakes action-platformer. Command the captain and crew of a failing ship, master a unique dash-attack combat system, and fight to survive the unforgiving depths of deep space.

English*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13+ (High Sierra or later)
  • Processor: Any Intel or Apple Silicon processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (or Apple M1 integrated GPU)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
